label: Любовь
description: Singular case ladder for любовь (feminine 3rd-declension, 'love') with its fleeting vowel: the о drops in all oblique forms (любовь → любви, любовью).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 1. 'Любовь' is the dictionary form, nominative singular predicate after 'это'. 2. The о is kept here; it only drops in oblique cases. 3. A natural identifying sentence.

Strategic focus: Adjective agreement. 1. 'Первая' is feminine nominative singular agreeing with 'любовь'. 2. The noun stays nominative with the о intact. 3. A very common collocation in past narration.
Strategic focus: Adjective agreement. 1. 'Настоящая' is feminine nominative singular and agrees with 'любовь'. 2. Nominative keeps the о. 3. A natural, emotive existential sentence.

Strategic focus: Adjective agreement. 1. 'Большая' is feminine nominative singular matching 'любовь', the subject of 'связывает'. 2. The noun remains nominative with the о. 3. A common descriptive collocation.
Strategic focus: Possessive agreement. 1. 'Моя' is the feminine possessive agreeing with 'любовь', a nominative predicate. 2. Nominative singular, о intact. 3. A warm, everyday declaration.
Strategic focus: Coordination. 1. 'Любовь' and 'счастье' are both nominative, joined by 'и', subjects of 'нужны'. 2. Both keep their full stem here. 3. A familiar paired expression.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. 1. 'Любовь' is the direct object of 'ценю'. 2. This 3rd-declension feminine noun has accusative identical to nominative, so the о stays. 3. A clear transitive sentence.
Strategic focus: Nominative with prepositional object. 1. 'Любовь' is nominative subject; 'к детям' (dative) names its target. 2. The о stays in the head noun. 3. A standard 'любовь к' collocation.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 1. 'Нет' requires the genitive, giving 'любви'. 2. FLEETING VOWEL: the о drops, любовь → любви (not 'любови'). 3. A common negation-of-existence pattern.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 1. 'Любви' is genitive singular modifying 'история'. 2. FLEETING VOWEL: о drops in the oblique form, любовь → любви. 3. A natural 'love story' phrase.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 1. 'Без' governs the genitive, giving 'любви'. 2. FLEETING VOWEL: the о drops, любовь → любви. 3. A frequent prepositional collocation.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 1. 'Благодаря' takes the dative, here 'любви'. 2. 3rd-decl syncretism: gen=dat=prep all give 'любви'. 3. FLEETING VOWEL: о drops, любовь → любви.

Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 1. 'В' with the abstract sphere takes the prepositional, 'любви'. 2. For this noun gen=dat=prep are identical (любви). 3. FLEETING VOWEL: the о drops, любовь → любви.
Strategic focus: Prepositional collocation. 1. 'Признался в' governs the prepositional 'любви'. 2. FLEETING VOWEL: о drops, любовь → любви. 3. A set phrase meaning 'confessed his love'.
Strategic focus: Prepositional collocation. 1. 'Клянусь в' takes the prepositional 'любви'. 2. FLEETING VOWEL: the о drops in this oblique form, любовь → любви. 3. A natural vow expression.

Strategic focus: Instrumental object. 1. 'Наслаждаюсь' governs the instrumental 'любовью'. 2. FLEETING VOWEL: о drops, любовь → любовью. 3. The ending '-ью' is typical of feminine 3rd-declension nouns.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 1. 'Любовью' is instrumental, expressing what one lives by. 2. FLEETING VOWEL: о drops, любовь → любовью. 3. A poetic but natural construction.

Strategic focus: Instrumental with possessive. 1. 'Дорожу' governs the instrumental 'любовью'; 'твоей' agrees in instrumental. 2. FLEETING VOWEL: о drops, любовь → любовью. 3. A heartfelt everyday phrase.
